# BEES HUB FARMLAND PRIVATE LIMITED (Bees Hub Farmland)

> Farm-sourced raw forest honey, solar-dehydrated superfood powders, wood cold-pressed virgin oils, and turnkey private-label packaging from Kanyakumari District, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Core Storefront & B2B Pages
- [Bees Hub Farmland Homepage](https://beeshubfarmland.com/): Overview of B2C retail products, B2B wholesale supply, certifications, and FAQs.
- [Shop All Farm-Sourced Products](https://beeshubfarmland.com/shop): Full catalog across Natural Honey, Superfood Powders, Cold-Pressed Oils, Dehydrated Products, Natural Food Ingredients, and Other Farm Products.
- [Wholesale & Processing Services](https://beeshubfarmland.com/services): Bulk honey drums (30kg–300kg), 25kg dehydrated powder lots, Marachekku cold-pressed oil production, and quality specifications.
- [Private Label & Contract Bottling](https://beeshubfarmland.com/private-label): Cleanroom bottling in Square, Hexa, Octa, and ITC glass jar series starting from 100 pilot units.
- [Wedding & Corporate Gift Hampers](https://beeshubfarmland.com/gift): Curated pine-wood wellness gift chests with custom laser engraving for events and corporate gifting.
- [About Bees Hub Farmland](https://beeshubfarmland.com/about): Kanyakumari sourcing story, FSSAI Central (`12425009000671`), ISO `9001:2015`, ISO `22000:2018`, GMP, and IEC (`AAOCB0453D`) credentials.
- [Contact & Trade Desk](https://beeshubfarmland.com/contact): Registered address in Nagercoil, Kanyakumari, phone `+91 95787 84431`, and email `admin@beeshubfarmland.com`.
- [The Farmland Journal (Blog)](https://beeshubfarmland.com/blog): Educational articles on honey purity, superfood processing, and regional farming.
- [Shipping Policy](https://beeshubfarmland.com/shipping-policy): Retail free shipping across India, order tracking, and commercial bulk freight terms.
- [Return & Refund Policy](https://beeshubfarmland.com/return-policy): Support workflow for damaged, leaked, or incorrect deliveries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://beeshubfarmland.com/privacy-policy): Customer order, enquiry, and Razorpay payment data handling.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://beeshubfarmland.com/terms): Storefront pricing, GST invoicing, and B2B supply terms.
